insights.summary: Signal AI spam detection flags legitimate after-hours or weekend callers as spam, removing real customers from reporting.
insights.quote: We run after-hours HVAC calls through the main tracking numbers, and a chunk of them get flagged as spam and drop out of the reporting.

insights.summary: Customer links "signal ai mislabels after-hours callers as spam" to the renewal decision.
insights.quote: If our after-hours calls keep getting mislabeled, we'll have to look at other options before January.
